LESSON: SELF-ESTEEM ASSESSMENT

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Social Studies Personal Management
Topic 1.2: Self-Esteem Assessment
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Self-Esteem Assessment, part of Social Studies Personal Management in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How does self- esteem affect my holistic development?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the contribution of self-esteem on their holistic development,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Self-Esteem Assessment in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. determine effects of unhealthy self-esteem in day-to-day social lives,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Self-Esteem Assessment in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. assess their self-esteem in social interactions,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Self-Esteem Assessment in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. desire to improve their self- esteem for personal productivity.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Self-Esteem Assessment in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. explain the contribution of self-esteem on their holistic development,

   Self-Esteem Assessment helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. determine effects of unhealthy self-esteem in day-to-day social lives,

   Self-Esteem Assessment helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. assess their self-esteem in social interactions,

   Self-Esteem Assessment helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. desire to improve their self- esteem for personal productivity.

   Self-Esteem Assessment helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

E. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

Light intensity should be controlled for learners who may be photosensitive,

2. refer to religious texts on self-love,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. use digital or print resources to search for and discuss the relationship between self-esteem and personal productivity, learners with manipulation difficulties could be provided with adapted digital resources with appropriate accessibility features or be supported by peers, learner support assistant or teacher to manipulate the digital/print resources. Light intensity should be controlled for learners who may be photosensitive,
2. refer to religious texts on self-love,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Self-Esteem Assessment together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: Learners develop speaking skills as they discuss cultural beliefs that promote self- esteem.

• Digital literacy: Learners use digital devices to search for the relationship between self-esteem and personal productivity.

Values:
• Love: Learners honestly journalise on steps they would take to improve their self-esteem.

• Responsibility: Learners commit themselves through journalising actions they will take to improve their self-esteem.

Link to Other Subjects:

• Religious Education: Learners discuss about self-love from religious texts.

• Kenyan Sign Language, Kiswahili and English: Learners make journal entries on steps they would take to improve their

self-esteem.

Main points to remember:
